purpose: Determine whether first-party MINDCAF/cadastre evidence links a local Maroua/Diamaré registry custodian, separating it from MINHDU urban-planning services.
assessment: Maroua is officially identified as the chief town of the Diamaré department. MINDCAF’s official 2023 statistical yearbook and organization material establish that its departmental delegations include a Departmental Cadastre Service and Land Conservation. However, neither the official yearbook nor the MINDCAF materials reviewed identify a Diamaré/Maroua MINDCAF delegation or say it serves Maroua. The locally named MINHDU office is a different ministry and is not evidence of cadastre custody. Consequently the city-local MINDCAF custody link remains unestablished and should stay null under the requested evidence standard.
registryBasis: No first-party MINDCAF source found that identifies a Diamaré or Maroua cadastre/land-registry office. National organization rules say departmental delegations contain a cadastre service and land conservation; MINAT identifies Maroua as the Diamaré chief town. That administrative linkage is insufficient to establish the local MINDCAF office or WUP-point title coverage. MINHDU planning office evidence is separate and not transferable.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official MINDCAF statistical yearbook. Pages 17–18 describe regional and departmental delegations; the latter contain a Service Départemental du Cadastre and Conservation Foncière. Search/find of this document returned no “Diamaré” or “Maroua” match, so it does not establish a locality-specific office.

Official ministry organization page reproduces decree 2012/390; Articles 104 and 110 describe the jurisdiction and cadastral functions of generic departmental MINDCAF delegations/services. It does not name Maroua or Diamaré.
Official MINAT regional page states Maroua is chief town of the Diamaré department and of the Far North region. This locates the city administratively, but does not identify MINDCAF custody.
MINHDU source identifies a local planning/urban-development office; MINHDU is institutionally distinct from MINDCAF and this page is not evidence of cadastral or land-registry custody.

searchQueries.result: Search did not locate a first-party MINDCAF page identifying a Maroua or Diamaré cadastral office. Official national MINDCAF organization material and MINAT administrative geography were reviewed; together they do not establish that office’s local presence or jurisdiction.
searchQueries.method: Separate English-language web search and first-party source review.

searchQueries.query: Maroua cadastre MINDCAF délégation départementale Diamaré cadastre officiel
searchQueries.result: Search found MINDCAF’s official national organization/delegation rules and official MINAT geography linking Maroua as chef-lieu of Diamaré, but no MINDCAF result naming a local Diamaré/Maroua cadastral delegation. The MINHDU contact result is a different custodian. A non-government academic/other directory result was excluded.
searchQueries.method: Separate French-language web search, then official MINDCAF and MINAT source review.

geometryAssessment: No parcel geometry or title lookup was requested. This assessment does not infer parcel coverage at the WUP point from administrative geography.
recommendation: Retain registryFound=null until a first-party MINDCAF source explicitly names the Diamaré/Maroua delegation, cadastre service, or land conservation office. Do not count MINHDU urban-planning evidence as registry custody. No existing packet was edited.
